cohort: The study describes a single infant patient, the younger of a set of twins born at 36 weeks and 6 days gestation, diagnosed with familial nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism, along with their mother who carried the same mutation.
finding: A heterozygous variant of c.1800C>T (p.Ala627Val) in the TSHR gene was identified as the cause of familial nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism in the patient, confirming it as a germline variant and representing the second reported case.
